title: Can Claude replace Productboard? 25/25 checks, 20 spec gaps #shorts
description:
Claude built a Productboard alternative, a customer feedback inbox that ties every quote to an account and its revenue, ranks themes and lists who to tell when a feature ships, from one written spec: all 25 acceptance checks passed, and the build exposed 20 gaps in the spec.

Full build test (2:42): https://youtu.be/4kp4XEZR1Iw
The free spec: https://personalsoftwarefactory.com/blueprints/feedback-inbox
Productboard pricing and alternatives: https://personalsoftwarefactory.com/alternatives/productboard

Productboard does not publish prices: Business is sold through a demo (minimum of 5 makers) and Enterprise through sales (productboard.com/pricing, October 2026).

Made with AI: Sam's on-camera hook and outro are an AI avatar of him, and the narration is his AI voice clone (HeyGen). The product footage is from the real test build.

Music: "Chill Wave" by Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com). Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License, http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
